tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Free-text search over the AI tools directory (names, aliases, subtitles, descriptions), ranked like the search on automateandtweak.com, with optional category / tag / listing type / pricing filters. Returns compact tool cards with canonical URLs; call get_tool for details.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full public details of one AI tool by slug: description, pricing types and price, categories, tags, listing types, website link, FAQs, pros and cons, similar tools, rating, verified flag, status and canonical URL. For offline or merged tools it says so and returns the replacement or alternatives.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All active tool categories with localized names, number of live tools and canonical URLs. Use the slug as `category` filter in search_tools / list_tools.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: All active tags with localized names, number of live tools and canonical URLs, most used first. Use the slug as `tag` filter.

tools.name: list_types
tools.description: All active listing types (e.g. online tool, app, plugin) with localized names, number of live tools and canonical URLs. Use the slug as `type` filter.

tools.name: list_pricing_types
tools.description: All active pricing types (free, freemium, subscription, ...) with localized names, number of live tools and canonical URLs. Use the slug as `pricing` filter.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Browse the directory without a search text, filtered by category, tag, listing type and/or pricing type, sorted like the site listing (newest first by default). Paginated: pass the returned `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next page.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side data for 2 or 3 tools (pricing, categories, pros and cons, rating, website). Includes the canonical comparison page URL when that pair has a public comparison page on the site; this tool never creates comparisons.

tools.name: new_tools
tools.description: The most recently listed AI tools (newest first) with listing dates and canonical URLs.
